conclusions.text: All 56,626 original land cells, 17,520 intervals and 70 owners are accounted for and supported by genuine stock source-relative authority, with zero exact prior-source-family contacts. Complete source, physical, historical and role context remain.

All selected semantic/parent-role questions, original whole-source and historical whole-candidate unknowns, prior Bounty/Nukunonu source-fitness disagreements, GSHHG wording conflict, contemporary legal/dry-land claims and selected/current-owner-zero/emitted delivery remain open or pending.

limits: No selected ownership, cumulative ledger, emitted raster, regional certificate, deployment or accepted repair credit changes in this source-authority handoff.

Complete NZL ADM1 and ADM2 contain 17 and 88 actual features and 4,418,605 decoded original bytes. Represented-year claims are 2017/2021, source update January 2023 and build December 2023. Consumed simplified source URLs, explicit OGC CRS84 and CC BY 4.0 notices are retained distinctly from advertised unsimplified products. Product feature counts are completeness checks; global screening counts are actual outcomes.

The 70 direct owners have three different roles: 48 territorial authorities / 49,168 original cells, 21 Auckland local boards / 6,928 cells, and Area Outside Territorial Authority offshore residual / 530 cells. All 22 recorded role corrections, ten reversible UTF8/Latin1 source-name corrections, complete parent chains and selected semantic followup remain. Generic canonical Territorial Authorities metadata does not imply equivalent administrative roles or current legal jurisdiction. The offshore residual is not Bay of Plenty alone.

All 35 issue-bearing whole-physical results remain. Native support does not certify complete targets, inland-water semantics or present dry land. GSHHG retained data licence and README differ on LGPL version wording. No source clipping, reprojection or geometry repair is introduced.

Foreign ownerless, complete country and all 4,572 foreign ADM1 screens use complete products and exact original native centres. Zero contacts do not establish current sovereignty or regional completeness; uncovered reference centres remain unknown. All 94 current NZL cohort owners, including 88 geoBoundaries and six registered Natural Earth owners, remain in native membership.

All 325 historical overlapping candidates and their original whole-candidate unknowns remain, including seven without NZL tags. Complete 95,173-candidate reconstruction and full routing, not country filtering, determines overlap.

Prior Bounty #521 and corrected-overlap #569 / PR #1292 findings remain. Complete original Bounty and Nukunonu OSM and GSHHG families have zero original native contacts. This does not resolve original 27-ring/14-polygon/22-rock crosswalk differences, area disagreement, shoreline vintage, registration, parent semantics or unobserved omitted islands. The 906-record retained selected GSHHG stream is not the entire worldwide archive. Only exact authenticated parser function bodies from the prior reproducer are reused; its legacy writer is not executed.

The separate 20,477-cell / 67-owner physical-interpretation companion is retained and uncredited. Accepted overlap at the author baseline d4968ddc37aa3aa6105e9610c9e6fadbb368ba14 is zero; current accepted overlap and selected ownership must be rechecked at delivery.

Actual stock diagnostic and constructor both qualify all exact original 56,626 land keys. Authority retains the original whole source evidence and original patch byte-for-byte, without a redundant supported-only rewrite. No specific prior island source-fitness hold applies because complete prior source families have zero exact original contacts; their original findings remain unresolved.

Actual package producer/accounting executions and twelve actual occupied/dangling-symlink custom-writer refusals are reported. No whole application or hosted emitted consumer test is claimed. Stock budgets are cooperative phase allowances, not a hard process memory supervisor.
